title: Reserved work can become blocked and still be closed by agent finish
description: Evidence: dependency insertion can derive blocked status while preserving reservationId; finishReservedWork accepts the active reservation, and blocker checks only run for unreserved one-shot finishes. Impact: an agent can close work after a new blocker is added.
acceptanceCriteria: Reserved finish/close rechecks graph-derived blockers or releases/blocks the reservation path, with a regression for adding a dependency after reservation.
